verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a first-class expiration_date feature that stops memories from surfacing once the date passes without deleting them, working on both Platform and Open Source (mem0-docs-11, mem0-docs-19, mem0-docs-37, mem0-docs-50, mem0-docs-58). This directly satisfies the 'expiration date' part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit TTL (duration-based) configuration syntax, recency-weighting/decay scoring in search ranking, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
